title: The Last Dry Seat
tests: Turns two described characters and a simple story into one assembled 15-second film with a readable setup, kind gesture and resolution.

faults.what: The film is not silent: the supplied audio report identifies audible speech, "Wenn ich nur wüsste."

judge.summary: The natural-looking park encounter largely matches the requested characters and ending, but audible dialogue violates the explicit silence requirement.

must_haves.item: One playable 15-second widescreen film contains three sequential scenes, not separate clip deliverables.
must_haves.why: One approximately 15-second widescreen video is supplied, but the four sampled frames do not establish whether it contains three distinct sequential scenes.

must_haves.item: The woman has a curly black bob and yellow raincoat; the man has a white beard and blue coat.
must_haves.why: Both characters visibly match the requested hair, beard, and clothing.

must_haves.item: The opening visibly establishes that the park bench is wet.
must_haves.why: The opening sample shows a glossy, visibly wet bench, with puddles and wet pavement reinforcing the setting.

must_haves.item: The man offers a folded newspaper as a dry place to sit, and the ending shows both characters seated together and smiling.
must_haves.why: The man holds a folded newspaper, the woman places newspaper on the seat, and the ending shows them seated together and smiling. However, the actual offer or handoff is not established by these sampled frames.

must_haves.item: The film has a live-action appearance and no audible soundtrack.
must_haves.why: The images have a convincing live-action appearance, but the supplied audio report confirms audible speech.

case_name: Fact piece about a real thing
title: Meet the Real F-35A
tests: Tests whether a short factual aircraft film preserves the named variant's visible geometry and operating characteristics.

faults.what: The requested labels are replaced by garbled text; neither factual label appears correctly or in a clear sequential presentation.

The aircraft is a synthetic fighter hybrid rather than a convincing real F-35A: the elongated canopy, external tank-like shapes, wing-mounted fin-like protrusions, and exhaust geometry do not match the requested aircraft.
Aircraft details visibly change between views, including the tail arrangement, rear exhaust housing, and landing-gear configuration.

judge.summary: The widescreen clip shows a runway departure and flight with correct English narration, but garbled labels and an inaccurate, changing aircraft design make it unsuitable as an F-35A documentary.

must_haves.item: The aircraft has the recognizable F-35 configuration: one rear engine exhaust, two outward-canted vertical tails and no canards.
must_haves.why: A rear exhaust and paired tails are visible, but the aircraft's overall configuration and additional fin-like structures do not convincingly represent an F-35.

must_haves.item: The takeoff shows a forward runway roll and lift-off, not hovering or a vertical launch.
must_haves.why: The sequence progresses from wheels on the runway to a nose-up departure just above it, then airborne flight.

must_haves.item: The same aircraft design remains consistent between the runway and airborne views.
must_haves.why: The rear fuselage, exhaust housing, fin arrangement, and landing gear change visibly across the supplied frames.

must_haves.item: All three requested labels appear exactly and are legible.
must_haves.why: The title is misspelled, 'One engine' is absent, and the takeoff caption is garbled.

must_haves.item: Audible English narration correctly describes one engine and conventional runway takeoff without attributing F-35B hover capability to the F-35A.
must_haves.why: The supplied speech transcript explicitly states that the F-35A has one engine and takes off conventionally from a runway, with no hover claim.

title: Seed Growth With Supplied Narration
tests: Tests whether a supplied script becomes verbatim audible narration synchronized with an explanatory visual sequence.

exact_text.text: A seed takes in water. Roots grow downward, and a shoot reaches up toward the light.
exact_text.read_as: A seed takes in water. Roots grow downward, and a shoot reaches up toward the light.

judge.summary: A clean widescreen animation shows watering, downward root growth, and an upward shoot with the exact requested narration and no visible defects.

must_haves.item: One approximately 8-second widescreen video shows an animated seed sprouting.
must_haves.why: The supplied clip is 8 seconds long, and the widescreen frames show successive stages of seed germination.

must_haves.item: The audible voice-over says the supplied script verbatim, without extra spoken lines.
must_haves.why: The supplied speech transcription matches the requested script exactly and contains no additional lines.

must_haves.item: Water reaches the seed, roots grow downward, and a shoot grows upward toward light in that order.
must_haves.why: The frames show water contacting the seed first, roots extending downward next, and a green shoot extending upward into the light last.

must_haves.item: The corresponding growth stages appear while the narration describes them.
must_haves.why: The visual stages follow the narration's order, but the untimed transcript does not establish precise speech-to-animation synchronization.

must_haves.item: There is no on-screen text or music.
must_haves.why: No on-screen text is visible, but the supplied audio information does not establish whether background music is absent.

case_name: Mood or music piece, no dialogue
title: Quiet After the Rain
tests: Tests whether a short silent film conveys a specified mood through imagery, lighting and movement rather than dialogue or explanatory text.

judge.summary: A slow approach toward an empty, softly lit roadside bus shelter and rain-wet pavement creates the requested peaceful melancholy, though silence cannot be verified from still frames.

must_haves.item: The delivered video lasts approximately 10 seconds and is landscape 16:9.
must_haves.why: The supplied clip information identifies a 10-second video, and the frames are 1024 × 576, a 16:9 landscape format.

must_haves.item: A lonely bus stop at night is clearly visible, with wet surfaces or puddles establishing recent rain.
must_haves.why: An empty illuminated roadside shelter stands beside a deserted road, with large puddles and reflective wet pavement in the dark blue nighttime setting.

must_haves.item: Subdued lighting and unhurried pacing convey a melancholy, peaceful mood rather than suspense or excitement.
must_haves.why: Muted blue surroundings, a single warm shelter light, and a gradual approach across the sampled frames create a quiet, contemplative atmosphere.

must_haves.item: There is visible gentle movement, such as rippling reflections or a slow camera move, rather than a static image held for the entire clip.
must_haves.why: The shelter progressively enlarges and shifts within the composition across the four frames, showing a gentle camera approach.

must_haves.item: The video is silent and contains no titles, captions or dialogue.
must_haves.why: No titles, captions, or readable text appear in the supplied frames, but silence and the absence of spoken dialogue cannot be verified without audio.
